question: 'The Deccan Sabha' was founded by which of the following nationalists?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gopal Krishna Gokhale.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Deccan Sabha was founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale, who was a prominent Indian nationalist and social reformer.**
 
• Gokhale was a member of the Indian National Congress and played a key role in the early stages of the Indian independence movement.
 
• The Deccan Sabha was a political organization founded in 1896 in Pune, India.
 
• The organization aimed to promote social and political reforms in the Deccan region of India and played a key role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• **Other prominent members of the Deccan Sabha included Gopal Krishna Gokhale's mentor, Mahadev Govind Ranade, and the social reformer, Dhondo Keshav Karve.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Born in Bombay, Sir Pherozeshah Merwanjee Mehta was an Indian politician and attorney. **

 
 
• In 1873, he was elected as the Bombay Municipality's municipal commissioner and served as its president four times.
 
 
 
• **During British rule, Surendranath Banerjee led the Indian nationalist movement.**
 
 
• In order to unite Hindus and Muslims for political action, he formed the Indian National Association, a nationalist group.
 
 
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji was an Indian politician, academic, writer, and trader.**
 
 
• From 1886 to 1887, 1893 to 1894, and 1906 to 1907, he presided over the Indian National Congress as its second, ninth, and twenty-second president.
